ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) pixels covering approximately 85-90% of the visible ventral area, contrasted with low-intensity (black) pixels along the trailing edges and median notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white geometric area across both lobes. Black boundary band along the trailing edge. Vertical dark pigmentation band extending from the median notch vertex. Multiple small, isolated dark focal spots scattered on the interior white field of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with an estimated internal pixel angle of 45 degrees; notch depth occupies approximately 10% of the vertical fluke height in view.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying amplitudes along the entire trailing edge; notably more jagged with distinct peaks on the left lobe compared to the right.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory on both lobes; the right lobe distal tip displays an irregular, non-geometric expansion caused by surface accumulation.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, high-density cluster of tan/white circular pixel groups on the distal tip of the right lobe. Isolated dark circular pixel clusters (mottling) on the lower central region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the far right lobe tip; irregular, jagged trailing edge consistent with accumulated physical wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent vertical dark pigmentation streak originating at the median notch and extending downward into the ventral white field.
